name: signin_analyse
description: Read an Entra or Workspace sign-in export and surface what decides a cloud case: failures before a success, a success that satisfied only one factor on an account that has more, sign-ins from an address or a client seen nowhere else, and pairs whose implied travel speed is impossible.

path.description: A sign-in log export, CSV or JSON

max_speed_kmh.description: Implied speed above which a pair is flagged (default 900)
